annotation.title_clean: Research on the Application of Humanoid Robots in Tax Law Course Teaching
annotation.title_en: Research on the Application of Humanoid Robots in Tax Law Course Teaching
annotation.venue: Journal of Intelligence and Knowledge Engineering
annotation.summary_en: Journal article examining humanoid robots in university tax law teaching: scenarios (explanation, case simulation, Q&A), early outcomes, and challenges (technical immaturity, cost, acceptance, ethics and privacy, interdisciplinary integration). It proposes tiered adoption, human-machine collaboration, specialised databases, and ethical guidelines with training.
key_provisions_or_claims: Humanoid robots can aid tax law teaching via explanation, case simulation and Q&A companionship.
Barriers include limited technological maturity, high costs, low acceptance, and ethical and privacy risks.
Recommends tiered application promotion and a human-machine collaboration teaching model.
Calls for specialised tax law knowledge and scenario databases and interdisciplinary teams.
Proposes formulating ethical guidelines and enhanced training for teachers.
